quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.text: Competitive tone was the biggest focus. I thought our guys brought it. They haven't competed probably at this level in a while, so it was awesome to see them come out like that. We had to make some adjustments towards the end because we didn't want to just be married to the clock. It's not about quantity, it's about quality and making sure we're instilling the winning habits and correcting the things when we're not doing it. It was a lively gym, so I give the guys a lot of credit. Obviously, you expect that day one, but I think there was an intentionality to, okay, this is what coach has been talking to us about on the side and now we're actually going to do it for the first time.
quotes.news_angle: Taylor Jenkins emphasizes competitive tone and intentionality during first practice
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the competitive tone was the biggest focus for the first day of practice. He noted that the team has not competed at this level in a while and praised the players for their intentionality.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.text: I'm probably defensive minded at heart, so when I get an opportunity to be laced up, I got basketball shoes on, I still got fire inside of me. So defensively, I told them that's got to be something that we have to have pride in, individually for sure, but collectively. How we want to play on offense, on selfishness, aggressive and discipline, we got to do that on the defensive side as well, but that's got to be our main stay. So when I can get up there and mix it up and obviously when I get on the guys and try to correct behaviors and build new habits, I want to be able to demonstrate that as well.
quotes.news_angle: Taylor Jenkins stresses defensive identity and discipline for the upcoming season
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says he is defensive minded at heart and wants the team to have pride in their defense. He emphasized that the team must be aggressive and disciplined on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.text: He's meant so much to me. He's a big brother to me. He's a big brother to so many other coaches. He's made a tremendous impact on me as a coach, but even more so as a man, as a husband and a father. We have a lot we can relate on, but he's stretched my ability to just know the meaning of life, know what the meaning is to be a servant as a coach and I think he embodies that every single day. He's had so much success as a player, as a coach, a head coach. He'll be a head coach in this league any day now, but to have him by my side, I went up to him right before, I'm so excited to share this journey with you.
quotes.news_angle: Taylor Jenkins praises assistant coach for his mentorship and impact
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says his assistant coach is like a big brother to him. He credited him for making a tremendous impact on his life as a coach and as a man, and said he is excited to share this journey with him.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.text: It's definitely going to be a part of it. Our processes, how we're going to create advantage through numbers and space initially, but one of our main triggers is going to be pick and roll. We've got some elite pick and roll ball handlers. I think the combination with some of our bigs, hopefully we can use that to our advantage to create advantages. But how we move off the ball, how we have five guys engaged in every single possession, my time in Memphis we lean into that very heavily. Dosed pick and rolls into it, but to make the point that our collective movement has to be the separating factor for us. It can't just be two guys trying to create an advantage and the other guys are just bystanders.
quotes.news_angle: Taylor Jenkins plans to utilize pick and roll and collective movement as offensive triggers
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the pick and roll will be a main trigger for the offense this season. He emphasized that collective movement is the key to creating advantages and that all five players must be engaged on every possession.
